personality_one_liner: Command-center precision ophthalmology platform combining cutting-edge AI neural screening with clinical authority.

spacing.rule: Generous command-center padding with tactile touch targets and precise vertical rhythm.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers, bottom tab bar, and scanner overlays
Pair blur with translucent cyan-tinted base for absolute clinical readability
dont's: Never blur dense data tables or biometric indicators
Do not exceed two blur surfaces per screen

screens.name: Landing
screens.purpose: Hero entry point featuring RETINA-DX branding, retinal-inspired scan animation, Start Screening CTA, and Coming Soon Glaucoma/AMD pipelines.

states.loading: Centered cyan pulse spinner over deep obsidian canvas.
states.error: Failed to load clinical datasets. Retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with safe-area padding. Top status bar, glowing neural hero element, tagline, primary CTA sticky at bottom, and modular pipeline cards below.

screens.name: Upload
screens.purpose: Fundus image acquisition supporting pre-loaded sample selector (Low-risk & Signs Detected) and camera/gallery file upload.

states.error: Image decode error. Please select a valid JPEG/PNG fundus scan.

screens.layout: Drop zone container with dashed cyan border, preview window, pre-loaded sample selector shelf, and sticky 'Analyze Image with AI' button.

screens.name: Analysis
screens.purpose: Real-time AI Neural Scanner with animated cyan scanning ring and progress steps: Image received, Preparing analysis, AI screening in progress.
screens.layout: Centered radial scanner with pulsing cyan waveforms, live progress percentage, step checklist, and abort/cancel fallback.

screens.name: Results
screens.purpose: Comprehensive retinal screening report card displaying risk badge, confidence %, detected biomarkers, recommendations, and exportable summary card.
screens.layout: Scrollable dashboard featuring top risk indicator banner, confidence metric gauge, biomarker breakdown chips, clinical recommendation block, export card, and 'Scan Another' CTA.

hero_retina.alt: Retinal fundus medical imaging clinical scan

sample_signs_detected.alt: Fundus scan with microaneurysms and exudates

instructions_to_main_agent: Build RETINA-DX following Dark-First Utility DARK personality with obsidian backgrounds, cyan highlights, Barlow Condensed and Satoshi typography, sticky bottom CTAs, smooth reanimated neural scanner, pre-loaded sample fundus selector, and comprehensive exportable screening report.
